Arceus

Normal

Sinnoh · Generation 4 · Mythical Pokémon

Arceus is a Normal-type Alpha Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 3.2 m tall and weighs 320 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is HP (120), with a base stat total of 720.
